question: What share of US small businesses reported using generative AI in 2025, and for which tasks (e.g., marketing content, customer service, writing) do they use it most, per surveys such as the US Chamber of Commerce, Census Bureau Business Trends and Outlook Survey, or Salesforce?
answer_summary: The US Chamber of Commerce found 58% of small businesses said they used generative AI in 2025, up from 40% in 2024, while the Census Bureau's broader BTOS measure showed about 18% of all firms using AI at end of 2025, so the figure depends heavily on the survey. Among business owners using AI, Bank of America's Ipsos survey found marketing (50%), content production (38%) and customer service (37%) the leading uses.

facts.claim: The US Chamber of Commerce's 2025 Empowering Small Business report found 58% of small businesses say they use generative AI, up from 40% in 2024.
facts.source_title: U.S. Chamber's latest Empowering Small Business report shows majority of businesses in all 50 states are embracing AI
facts.excerpt: 58% of small businesses say they use generative AI

facts.claim: A Federal Reserve note based on Census Bureau BTOS data put AI adoption at about 18 percent of firms at the end of 2025, after Census broadened the survey question in November 2025.
facts.source_title: Monitoring AI Adoption in the U.S. Economy
facts.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
facts.excerpt: Adoption stood at about 18 percent of firms at the end of 2025.

facts.claim: In Census Bureau BTOS data collected December 14, 2025 to May 3, 2026, less than 20% of firms with four or fewer employees reported using AI, versus 37% of firms with at least 250 employees.
facts.source_title: Large Firms With at Least 20 Employees Biggest AI Users
facts.excerpt: Less than 20% of firms with four or fewer employees reported using AI.

facts.claim: Among business owners who have integrated AI, Bank of America's 2025 Business Owner Report found the leading uses were marketing (50%), content production (38%) and customer service (37%).
facts.source_title: BofA Report: 74% of Small and Mid-Sized Business Owners Expect Revenue to Increase in the Next Year
facts.publisher: Bank of America (press release, via Stock Titan)
facts.excerpt: they are using it for marketing (50%), content production (38%), customer service (37%)

facts.claim: The Bank of America survey was run by Ipsos from September 11 to 23, 2025, with 819 small-business owners (2 to 99 employees) and 253 mid-sized owners, so task shares cover small and mid-sized owners combined.
facts.source_title: BofA Report: 74% of Small and Mid-Sized Business Owners Expect Revenue to Increase in the Next Year
facts.publisher: Bank of America (press release, via Stock Titan)
facts.excerpt: Ipsos ran the online survey from September 11 to 23, 2025

conflicts: Adoption levels differ widely: US Chamber (self-identified small businesses) says 58% use generative AI in 2025, while Census BTOS (all firms, any AI) shows about 18% at end of 2025 and under 20% for firms with 4 or fewer employees. Differences stem from sample, question wording (Census changed its question in Nov 2025) and generative AI vs. any AI.
Bank of America's 77% AI-integration figure is for small and mid-sized owners combined and not limited to generative AI.
gaps: No task breakdown found in the Chamber 2025 report page or Census BTOS public stories; Census does not report usage by individual function.
No Salesforce SMB-specific task percentages found.
Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses AI page returned 403, so it was not used; its 2025 vs 2026 survey date is unconfirmed.
BofA task shares are cited via a press-release mirror (Stock Titan), not bankofamerica.com, and are not generative-AI-specific.
